mean_track.rna_conditioned_atac: mandatory true baseline: training-only donor-balanced mean profile
mean_track.variant_to_regulation: mandatory allele-invariant baseline: exact zero delta, not directional evidence

context_only.rna_conditioned_atac: mandatory context-path ablation with full profile output
context_only.variant_to_regulation: mandatory allele-invariant ablation: exact zero delta

sequence_only.rna_conditioned_atac: mandatory parent-bound ablation with query context clamped to a training-only reference
sequence_only.variant_to_regulation: mandatory parent-bound sequence ablation; primary-output-compatible only after a gene/lineage crosswalk and exact implementation are registered

trans_only.rna_conditioned_atac: mandatory parent-specific trans-regulator-path ablation with full profile output
trans_only.variant_to_regulation: mandatory allele-invariant ablation: exact zero delta

nearest_regulatory_feature.variant_to_regulation: mandatory unsigned enhancer-gene-link and retrieval baseline

nearest_context.rna_conditioned_atac: mandatory training-bank retrieval baseline with full profile output
nearest_context.variant_to_regulation: mandatory retrieval baseline for accessibility delta, allelic direction, and eQTL retrieval only

shuffled_context.rna_conditioned_atac: mandatory parent-bound negative control for context dependence
shuffled_context.variant_to_regulation: mandatory parent-bound negative control; its output type can be scored on a primary endpoint but cannot establish an independent model

sequence_cnn_control.rna_conditioned_atac: mandatory standalone sequence baseline trained from scratch
sequence_cnn_control.variant_to_regulation: mandatory standalone accessibility/activity-delta baseline; no primary signed eQTL head is currently admitted

sequence_transformer_control.rna_conditioned_atac: mandatory standalone sequence baseline trained from scratch
sequence_transformer_control.variant_to_regulation: mandatory standalone accessibility/activity-delta baseline; no primary signed eQTL head is currently admitted

gse296875.eligible_use: Fit donor-level context and track statistics, RNA-conditioned ATAC heads, retrieval banks, and development controls inside outer folds. Same-nucleus links may support paired objectives after donor grouping.
gse296875.prohibited_use: Final external claim, global fit before donor splitting, or treating nuclei as biological replicates.

gse244832.eligible_use: Donor-compatible development comparison and error analysis under assay-native pseudobulk.
gse244832.prohibited_use: False RNA-to-ATAC cell pairing, prototype construction for the strict held lane, or pristine external claim.

gse281364.eligible_use: Outer-training or locus-cross-fitted accessibility/activity heads and retrospective direction diagnostics when allowed by TaskSpec.
gse281364.prohibited_use: Donor replication claims or final sealed confirmation.

gse281160.eligible_use: Frozen development diagnostics and model selection only under the registered locus split.

current_coloc_gwas.eligible_use: Training-only or cross-fitted retrieval/link endpoints under held locus and LD blocks.
current_coloc_gwas.prohibited_use: Causal-gene labels, signed cell-state regulatory truth, or biological-replicate inflation.

gse289173.eligible_use: One-time locked inference for endpoints whose complete eligible summaries exist, after prediction hashes are committed.
gse289173.prohibited_use: Any fit, mean, prototype, distance metric, context permutation, head, calibration, threshold, exclusion, or repair.

fnih_86_liver.eligible_use: One-time RNA-conditioned ATAC confirmation only if the predefined openness, rights, topology, endpoint, contamination, and power gate passes before selection lock.
fnih_86_liver.prohibited_use: Delaying development, retrospective relabeling as sealed after inspection, or assuming same-cell topology across assay types.

rna_conditioned_atac.target: Predict donor by cell-state ATAC profiles from DNA and allowed observed RNA/context without observed query ATAC.
rna_conditioned_atac.profile_requirement: Every applicable control must emit a full finite prediction on stable feature IDs and the evaluator's frozen profile axis. Embeddings or partial latent tracks are not predictions.
rna_conditioned_atac.fit_unit: Donor-level assay-native pseudobulk or explicitly same-nucleus training objective; donors remain the inferential units.
rna_conditioned_atac.held_query: Observed held RNA/context can be input only to models whose contract requires it. Held ATAC is evaluator-only. Process held donors without refitting normalization, features, means, prototypes, heads, or calibration.
rna_conditioned_atac.comparison: Conditional multinomial/profile-deviance skill over the outer-training cell-state mean, macro-averaged across held donor, cell type, and genomic block.

variant_to_regulation.target: Predict assay-native variant effects and, where explicitly supported, signed cell-type eQTL or ieQTL effects under held loci and LD blocks.
variant_to_regulation.primary_head_firewall: No eQTL-specific fit or calibration is allowed until a nonsealed signed-effect training source with eligible gene, lineage, allele, and reference crosswalk exists.
variant_to_regulation.zero_delta_controls: mean_track, context_only, and trans_only are required null ablations. Their zero ALT-minus-REF score is not evidence for direction, retrieval, or a biological null.
variant_to_regulation.unsigned_control: nearest_regulatory_feature is proximity only and cannot be evaluated as a signed allele predictor.
variant_to_regulation.allele_orientation: Normalize against GRCh38.p14, require forward-reference REF match, and score ALT minus REF. Restore reverse-complement outputs to forward coordinates and strand before any ensemble.

fit_and_selection_firewall.outer_fit: All normalization, gene or regulator selection, length or library transforms, donor pseudobulk, context mapper, mean, prototype, metric, retrieval bank, regulatory-feature universe, output head, permutation, calibration, and threshold are fitted or frozen inside the outer-training partition.
fit_and_selection_firewall.inner_selection: Use donor-grouped inner cross-validation crossed with the registered genomic or LD grouping where the endpoint is sequence dependent.
fit_and_selection_firewall.held_features: A held donor's RNA may be transformed or queried only under a locked inductive interface. It cannot update shared statistics or populate a training prototype bank.
fit_and_selection_firewall.held_outcomes: Held ATAC, cell-state labels used as outcomes, eQTL or ieQTL effects, MPRA outcomes, phenotype, and evaluation summaries remain evaluator-only.
fit_and_selection_firewall.parent_bound_rows: context_only, sequence_only, trans_only, and shuffled_context use the same eligible rows, output axis, split, seed set, and evaluator as their concrete parent. Only the declared pathway intervention differs.
fit_and_selection_firewall.one_standard_error_and_seed_rules: Controls remain through selection under the same fixed seeds, label budget, early stopping, and one-standard-error rule as the compared model; seeds measure stability, not biological replication.

donor_genomic_and_identity_firewall.donor: Group by cohort_family_id plus resolved person key. Keep every modality and aliquot from one person in one outer fold.
donor_genomic_and_identity_firewall.genomic: For sequence-dependent tasks, cross held donors with held chromosome, locus, or ancestry-matched native-build LD blocks. Merge variants within 1 Mb or r2 >= 0.8 in any represented ancestry.
donor_genomic_and_identity_firewall.sequence_identity: Exact sequences, near-identical windows, and reverse-complement-equivalent windows remain in one split group.
donor_genomic_and_identity_firewall.boundary: Remove a buffer equal to the largest receptive field among all admitted comparison models at every outer boundary. A smaller native control cannot use a smaller buffer.
donor_genomic_and_identity_firewall.GSE244832: Same donor does not imply same cell. Only donor-level pseudobulk or another topology-valid comparison is allowed.
donor_genomic_and_identity_firewall.GSE296875: Same-nucleus RNA and ATAC may be paired, but all nuclei from one donor remain together and nuclei do not supply independent inferential n.
donor_genomic_and_identity_firewall.permutation: Freeze a deterministic, outcome-blind permutation from stable IDs and a fixed seed inside legal split and topology strata. Record singleton strata and do not silently widen them.

mean_context_and_retrieval_crosswalk.mean_track: Compute equal-donor assay-native means after donor pseudobulk, separately for each frozen task stratum. Denominators and missing-state exclusions are recorded per feature.
mean_context_and_retrieval_crosswalk.reference_context: Compute the context mean after the exact training-only mapper. It is a fixed reference input for sequence-only ablations, not a statistic recomputed on held RNA.
mean_context_and_retrieval_crosswalk.nearest_context: Use a training-only prototype bank and locked metric. Query RNA can choose a prototype without changing the bank; held ATAC and outcomes never participate in neighbor selection.
mean_context_and_retrieval_crosswalk.shuffled_context: Do not build a permutation pool from sealed outcomes or from records across outer partitions. Held query contexts may only be permuted under an explicitly registered outcome-blind held-query rule; otherwise use a training-only context bank.
mean_context_and_retrieval_crosswalk.fallback: No model may silently fall back from unavailable context to mean context. The state is missing unless the exact model specification declares the mean reference as its intended input.

reference_sign_and_strand_crosswalk.reference: GRCh38.p14 FASTA and GENCODE v49 under their admitted hashes and coordinate contract; BED intervals are 0-based half-open.
reference_sign_and_strand_crosswalk.variant: Left-normalize in the native build, require a unique admitted mapping and reference allele match, and preserve forward-reference REF/ALT labels.
reference_sign_and_strand_crosswalk.delta: Signed allele output is always score(ALT)-score(REF). REF/ALT swap must negate the score within tolerance.
reference_sign_and_strand_crosswalk.strand: For reverse-complement inference, transform both alleles, restore positions and strand-specific output channels, and then combine. Reverse complement never changes the allele contrast definition.
reference_sign_and_strand_crosswalk.indels: Freeze anchor, window resizing, and output realignment. If an implementation supports only SNVs, indels are not_applicable or untestable, never zero.
reference_sign_and_strand_crosswalk.distance_baseline: nearest_regulatory_feature uses forward-genome interval distance and is unsigned; gene strand does not change distance sign.

missingness_crosswalk.rule: Missing evidence is not biological zero and cannot be encoded as zero-valued input or outcome without a separate observed mask.
missingness_crosswalk.means: Exclude nonobserved donor-feature values from mean denominators and persist counts. Do not mean-impute structurally absent assays.
missingness_crosswalk.retrieval: A missing query context or empty eligible training bank produces an explicit missing prediction. It does not trigger cross-lineage, cross-assay, or mean fallback.
missingness_crosswalk.profiles: Filtered peaks, unmappable loci, unsupported alleles, missing masks, and output-axis mismatches are reported separately rather than dropped after outcome inspection.

exposure_crosswalk.upstream_pretraining: None for standalone project baselines. Parent-bound ablations use only the exact parent's registered artifacts and inherit their strictest checkpoint exposure class.
exposure_crosswalk.project_fit: Every fitted outer-training state is continual_seen for its own development donors and loci. It can be target_label_unexposed for a held source only with complete fold and feature receipts.
exposure_crosswalk.external_annotation: A regulatory-feature table used without target labels is reference_only only when its source, release, build, derivation, and source-overlap risks are registered.
exposure_crosswalk.sealed: Opening anonymized GSE289173 features for locked inference does not authorize any adaptation. Opening labels or effect summaries ends sealed status for all subsequent choices.

claim_boundary.true_baselines: mean_track, nearest_regulatory_feature, nearest_context, sequence_cnn_control, and sequence_transformer_control may be winning models only under exact self-owned implementations and endpoint-eligible sealed gates.
claim_boundary.ablations: context_only, sequence_only, and trans_only quantify pathway dependence. A parent-specific instance must be reported as an ablation of that parent and cannot inherit an independent family or champion identity.
claim_boundary.negative_control: shuffled_context tests whether the parent uses correctly matched context. It is not a biological model or champion even if its output can be scored on a primary endpoint.
claim_boundary.variant_language: Unsigned proximity or retrieval is candidate prioritization, not causal regulation. Zero delta is a null control, not proof of no effect.
claim_boundary.clinical: No diagnostic, prognostic, treatment-response, or deployment claim.

minimum_per_selected_control: Immutable implementation ID, source hash, and dirty-patch receipt
Exact architecture or deterministic algorithm, preprocessing, output axis, and model-state format
Complete runtime and license or redistribution audit
Task capability receipt including sign, strand, missingness, and full-profile behavior
Donor-by-genomic split and largest-receptive-field buffer receipt
Fixed-fixture pass without query ATAC or held-outcome access
activation_gate.selection_rule: Do not register one generic implementation for multiple scientifically different controls. Every executable role owns its implementation receipt; every parent-bound ablation additionally names the parent artifact it tests.

interpretation: These controls answer different questions. Mean and nearest-neighbor methods test whether learned models beat simple task-native structure. Scratch CNN and transformer models test pretraining rather than architecture alone. Context-only, sequence-only, and trans-only isolate pathways inside a concrete model. Shuffled context is a negative control for matched biological context. Keeping these roles separate prevents an ablation from borrowing a parent model's evidence, receptive field, license, or champion identity.
